You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 8d59c48acc468dddffa92dbb44ce2d614f1fafbc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wilke Schwiedop <drwilly@drwilly.de>
Date: Fri, 11 Oct 2013 21:17:49 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fixes error introduced in
 d51fc41b90784f71454c2478d153dab9b53ae690

---
 src/executor.c | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/src/executor.c b/src/executor.c
index c75d831..d29af3f 100644
--- a/src/executor.c
+++ b/src/executor.c
@@ -73,6 +73,8 @@ exec(const Ast *ast) {
 	case N_DECLARATION:
 		declaration(ast);
 		return;
+	case N_FUNCTION:
+		return;
 	case N_RETURN:
 		returnstat(ast);
 		return;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was introduced in a previous commit (d51fc41b90784f71454c2478d153dab9b53ae690) where the handling of the N_FUNCTION case in the exec function was likely omitted or incorrectly implemented, causing the function to not return properly when encountering a function node in the abstract syntax tree (AST). The patch adds a return statement for the N_FUNCTION case, ensuring that the function exits correctly when processing a function declaration, thus fixing the error.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was introduced in a previous commit (d51fc41b90784f71454c2478d153dab9b53ae690) where the handling of the N_FUNCTION case in the exec function was likely omitted or incorrectly implemented, causing the function to not return properly when encountering a function node in the abstract syntax tree (AST). The patch adds a return statement for the N_FUNCTION case, ensuring that the function exits correctly when processing a function declaration, thus fixing the error.

From 8d59c48acc468dddffa92dbb44ce2d614f1fafbc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Wilke Schwiedop <drwilly@drwilly.de>

index c75d831..d29af3f 100644
--- a/src/executor.c
+++ b/src/executor.c
@@ -73,6 +73,8 @@ exec(const Ast *ast) {
 	case N_DECLARATION:
 		declaration(ast);
 		return;
+	case N_FUNCTION:
